notTested: notTested (missing host capability): loaded-library OAuth login end to end (cdylib through `rpi auth login`) is not exercised. The production OAuth token/userinfo fetch is a direct reqwest client (src/auth/network.rs) with .no_proxy() and hardcoded Google endpoints (https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token and https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v1/userinfo?alt=json in src/auth.rs); there is no injectable endpoint, base URL or proxy hook, so a loopback fake server cannot intercept it and exercising it would require the real network, which this lane must not use. The rpi host binary available here also has no `auth methods` subcommand (only login/check/status/refresh/logout), which the existing loaded native-auth acceptance scripts require. Per CONTRACT rule 2 this is reported as a missing host capability, not worked around.
The malformed-JSON diagnostics cover valid UTF-8 bodies only; lone UTF-16 surrogate inputs are reported lossily because a Rust String cannot hold them.

Rust serde_json and V8 JSON.parse accept the same strict JSON, so the V8 diagnostic is only consulted after serde_json rejects a body; divergence is limited to inputs where serde_json rejects and V8 accepts (none found in the corpus).
